utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Repair drive? Oh, that sounds important. What's it about again?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Cleo told me it's a community thing where people bring broken stuff and others fix them up using donated parts.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right! That rings a bell. I've got a bunch of old tools in the garage that could come in handy.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Noah, I'm glad you're here. Can I count on you to help at the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, is it this Saturday? I could've sworn it was next week, but okay, I'll be there.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, I'll mark you down. And just to confirm, it's this Saturday at the community center from 10 to 4.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Need any tools for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Leo! I've got my toolbox ready, but extra hands are always welcome. Want to help out?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure, I'll be there.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Sam, don't forget the tool check meeting is Saturday morning at the community shed!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks for the reminder, Mara! I'll be there with my gear.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, see you there! Let's make this repair drive a success.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, are you sure this repair drive is going to work? I've heard mixed things about those.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, I think it's going great! Opal told me lots of people are already helping out with tools and stuff.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Hold on, Jules. Opal might be optimistic, but have you actually seen the drive in action or checked the specs yourself?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Eli! Have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday? It's at the community center parking lot from 9 to 3.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good morning, Tess. Saturday from 9 to 3, you say? That's good to know. Do we have a list of items people are bringing or a sign-up sheet?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I'm not sure about a sign-up sheet, but you could ask the organizers when you get there. They might have a list going.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yes, I'm planning to bring my toaster on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, I'll note that you're bringing a toaster on Saturday. What time were you thinking of coming by?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Probably around 11 AM, if that works.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes, it's this Saturday. I'm glad Leo is bringing a hammer.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Right, the community center event. Saturday works for me.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Good. See you there then.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, the repair drive is an event where we collect and fix broken toys and electronics from the school.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Actually, I heard it's for fixing old bikes and appliances too, not just school things. It's at the community center parking lot.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, I didn't realize it was for bikes and appliances too! That makes it even better.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Rosa, are you coming to the repair drive this Saturday at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Actually, it's at the community shed, not the center. But yes, I'll be there first thing Saturday morning!

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, the community shed! Got it. So we're all set for Saturday morning, right?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What needs fixing on the drive?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Not sure yet, but I can check with Ava—she's the organizer.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Alright, so when can you get back to me with an answer?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, the repair drive? Are we sure we have the right parts for it?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Not sure yet, Pia. Let me check with Gus if he's got a list of needed parts.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I hope Gus has the list. We really need to double-check the model number before we start.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hey Pia, are you planning to go to the repair drive this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I'm not sure yet—do we even know if we have the right parts for it?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I think they might have some spare parts, or we could figure it out together.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Kira, the repair drive's this weekend. We'll be fixing things at my place. Want to join?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, are you sure this repair drive is going to work? I've heard mixed things about those.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Kira, I think it'll work great – we've got a solid group of volunteers and plenty of tools. Give it a shot!

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Jules, did you know there's a repair drive at the community center parking lot this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yeah, I heard about it! I'm planning to be there Saturday morning—can't wait to see everyone pitching in.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh that's great! I was thinking of bringing my old blender—maybe they can work their magic on it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Vik, do you know what time the repair drive starts tomorrow?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, it starts at 10 AM and goes until 4 PM at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it, 10 AM to 4 PM at the community center. Thanks, Vik.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What needs fixing on the drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I've got a broken toaster I'm bringing, but I think they're taking pretty much any small appliances and electronics.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Wait, I was asking about the driveway—what repairs do you think it needs?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, this Saturday? Got it, I'll mark it on my calendar this time. Thanks for the reminder.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, see you then. I'll try to be on time this time.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I'll believe it when I see you walk through the door on time, Dane.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Quinn, I'm trying to figure out how to schedule the repair drive around school pickups. Any ideas?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Maybe we can start a bit later, like 10am? I can check with Ava if that works.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That sounds good, Quinn. Let me know what Ava says, and I'll plan the pickups around it.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Uli, are you coming to the tool check Saturday morning at the community shed? We could use your help sorting things out.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, I'll be there. I could use a hammer too, mine's broken.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, I'll bring my spare hammer for you.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let's sit down and list the tasks first, then we can set a timeline. I like to know exactly what we're doing.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Good idea, Eli. I've already spotted some cracks and loose gravel near the entrance.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let's start with that area then, it's probably the most visible.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Leo, Cleo told me about the repair drive. Are you getting involved?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, I'm in. Uli needs a hammer, so I'll bring one.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that's great! I was thinking of joining too—do you know if they need anything else?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I need you to keep a list of who's donating tools, what they're offering, and the times they're available to help out.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it, Rosa. I'll start a spreadsheet with columns for names, tools, and availability. Can you give me the first few donors so I can begin logging?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Sure, I can start you off. Mara and I are teaming up for tool check, so she'll be there. Also, Mr. Henderson mentioned he has some spare hammers he can bring.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Hey Bo, what's this repair drive all about again?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: It's at the community center. I think they're fixing up old stuff.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the community center! I might still have that old hammer somewhere. Should I bring it?

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
